# WaterSpeed

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** WaterSpeed

## What it does

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/WaterSpeed.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
